independent_lower_bound.source: independent exact domain-power floor plus Stage-copy q*d minima
assumptions: all accepted local temperatures remain in the declared power-model range

rules.rank: union shared-identity DAG; mean of fastest legal duration on each unit; zero transfer cost
rules.priority: ready shared identity by descending rank_u, then identity
rules.shared_unit: minimum weighted sum of inserted execution finish times, then weighted scene tail, then unit id
rules.insertion: each execution deadline/id order; minimum finish, start, activity energy, OPP id
rules.fallbacks: at most three additional high/middle/low OPP-rank constructions; no exclusion
rules.energy_adjustment: one deterministic unit/OPP/one-successor-start pass; full-safe interval-strict descent only
rules.coverage: bounded constructor/local neighborhood, not exhaustive; no optimality or infeasibility proof
